mapper.sql: join growth_board_visibility v on v.member_id = c.mid and v.visible = 1 left join member_progress_privacy p on p.member_id = c.mid
mapper.select:
select c.mid from ( select m.id as mid from ums_member m where m.area_id = #{areaId} and m.del_flag = 0 and m.role = 'player' ) c
where c.mid <> #{memberId} and ifnull(p.leaderboard_scope, 'IN') <> 'OUT' order by c.mid limit #{cap}
select area_id from ums_member where id = #{memberId} and del_flag = 0
mapper.update: update ums_member set area_id = #{areaId} where id = #{memberId} and del_flag = 0
mapper.select:
select m.id as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar,
ifnull(s.s, 0) as score, ifnull(g.exp_value, 0) as score, ifnull(s.s, 0) as score, ifnull(m.point, 0) as score,
m.create_time as createdAt from ums_member m
left join ( select member_id, sum(exp_value - revoked_exp) as s from member_exp_earned where exp_value > 0 and earned_at >= #{weekStart} and earned_at < #{weekEnd} and member_id in group by member_id ) s on s.member_id = m.id
left join member_growth g on g.member_id = m.id
left join ( select member_id, sum(change_points) as s from ums_member_points_detail where change_type = 1 and del_flag = 0 and create_time >= #{weekStart} and member_id in group by member_id ) s on s.member_id = m.id
where m.id in and m.del_flag = 0 and m.role = 'player'
select visible from growth_board_visibility where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: insert into growth_board_visibility (member_id, visible, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{visible}, #{now}) on duplicate key update visible = values(visible), update_time = values(update_time)
